engineered_features.N_CONDITIONS: Number of the 12 chronic conditions the person reports (0-12)
engineered_features.N_LIMITATIONS: Number of the 5 functional limitations the person reports (0-5)
engineered_features.ANY_LIMITATION: 1 if the person has at least one functional limitation
engineered_features.OUT_OF_SCOPE_1231: 1 if the person was not in the survey population on 31 Dec 2022 (died or institutionalized), detected by REGION22 = -1

threshold_rule: HIGH_COST = TOTEXP22 >= P80 of the training split
split: StratifiedGroupKFold(5), groups = DUID (household), strata = spending deciles
